quarterly_data.signal: Amkor's 10-Q reports capital expenditures of $688.4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026 versus $226.1 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025, primarily for advanced packaging and test equipment and the Arizona Facility. As of June 30, 2026, off-balance sheet purchase obligations for capital expenditures, long-term supply contracts and other contractual commitments were $1,465.2 million, with $1,395.1 million payable within 12 months.
